q: In 1951, for the first time, a majority of Canadians were able to afford what?
zq: 1951 年，大多數加拿大人第一次能夠負擔什麼？
zo: 足夠的食物、住所和衣物
e: Postwar Canada enjoyed record prosperity.
ze: 戰後加拿大享有空前的繁榮。

q: Which Act ensures common elements and a basic standard of health coverage?
zq: 哪部法律確保醫療保障的共同要素和基本標準？
e: Publicly funded education, by contrast, is provided by the provinces and territories.
ze: 公費教育則由各省和地區提供。

q: In what year did Canada help found La Francophonie?
zq: 加拿大在哪一年協助創立法語國家組織？
e: La Francophonie is an international association of French-speaking countries.
ze: 法語國家組織是法語國家的國際組織。

q: In 1982 the Constitution was amended without the agreement of which province?
zq: 1982 年憲法在未獲哪個省同意的情況下修訂？
e: The autonomy of Quebec within Canada remains a lively topic.
ze: 魁北克在加拿大之內的自主權仍是熱門話題。

q: In which year did Japanese-Canadians, the last group of Asian descent, gain the right to vote?
zq: 日裔加拿大人——最後一批亞裔——在哪一年獲得投票權？
e: Most Canadians of Asian descent had been denied the vote in the past.
ze: 過去大多數亞裔加拿大人被剝奪投票權。

q: Who painted the forests and Aboriginal artifacts of the West Coast?
zq: 誰描繪了西海岸的森林和原住民文物？
zo: 肯諾朱阿克・阿舍瓦克
e: Kenojuak Ashevak pioneered modern Inuit art; Riopelle led Les Automatistes.
ze: 阿舍瓦克開創現代因紐特藝術；里奧佩爾領導自動主義畫派。

q: Who became a world record sprinter and double Olympic gold medallist in 1996?
zq: 1996 年誰成為短跑世界紀錄保持人和奧運雙金得主？
e: Chantal Petitclerc became a world champion wheelchair racer.
ze: 尚塔爾・珀蒂克萊爾成為輪椅競速世界冠軍。

q: In 1985, who circled the globe in a wheelchair to raise funds for spinal cord research?
zq: 1985 年誰坐輪椅環繞全球為脊髓研究募款？
e: Rick Hansen, like Terry Fox, was from British Columbia.
ze: 瑞克・韓森和泰瑞・福克斯一樣來自卑詩省。

q: Who hit on the idea of the telephone at his summer house in Canada?
zq: 誰在他加拿大的避暑住宅想出了電話的點子？
zo: 亞歷山大・格拉漢姆・貝爾
e: Reginald Fessenden sent the first wireless voice message in the world.
ze: 雷金納德・費森登發送了世界第一則無線語音訊息。

q: Who invented the snowmobile?
zq: 誰發明了雪上摩托車？
zo: 約瑟夫－阿爾芒・龐巴迪
懷爾德・潘菲爾德醫師
e: The snowmobile is a light-weight winter vehicle.
ze: 雪上摩托車是輕型的冬季交通工具。

q: The responsibilities of the federal and provincial governments were defined in 1867 in which Act?
zq: 聯邦與省政府的職責在 1867 年由哪部法案訂定？
o: The British North America Act, now the Constitution Act, 1867
zo: 《英屬北美法案》，現稱《1867 年憲法法案》
e: Federalism lets provinces adopt policies tailored to their populations.
ze: 聯邦制讓各省能採用適合自己人口的政策。

q: Which of these is a provincial responsibility?
zq: 下列哪一項是省的職責？
e: Provinces handle municipal government, education, health, natural resources, property and civil rights, and highways.
ze: 省負責市鎮政府、教育、醫療、自然資源、財產與民事權利、公路。

q: Do the three northern territories have the status of provinces?
zq: 北方三個地區有省的地位嗎？
o: No, but their governments and assemblies carry out many of the same functions
No, they are governed directly by the Senate
zo: 沒有，但它們的政府和議會執行許多相同職能
沒有，由參議院直接管理
e: The territories have small populations and do not have provincial status.
ze: 地區人口稀少，沒有省的地位。

q: How often are members of the House of Commons traditionally elected?
zq: 眾議院議員傳統上多久選一次？
e: The House of Commons is the representative chamber elected by the people.
ze: 眾議院是人民選出的民意代表議事廳。

q: As Head of the Commonwealth, the Sovereign links Canada to how many other nations?
zq: 作為大英國協元首，君主把加拿大與其他多少個國家連結起來？
e: Commonwealth nations cooperate to advance social, economic and cultural progress.
ze: 國協國家合作推動社會、經濟和文化進步。

q: Which of these countries is NOT listed in the guide as a constitutional monarchy?
zq: 下列哪個國家不在指南列出的君主立憲國中？
e: Listed: Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Australia, New Zealand, the Netherlands, Spain, Thailand, Japan, Jordan and Morocco.
ze: 列出的有丹麥、挪威、瑞典、澳洲、紐西蘭、荷蘭、西班牙、泰國、日本、約旦和摩洛哥。

q: In Quebec, members of the provincial legislature are called what?
zq: 在魁北克，省議會的議員叫什麼？
e: MPPs in Ontario, MLAs in most provinces, MHAs in Newfoundland and Labrador.
ze: 安大略是 MPP，多數省 MLA，紐芬蘭是 MHA。

q: Which level of government usually includes a mayor (or reeve) and councillors?
zq: 哪一級政府通常包括市長（或鄉長）和議員？
e: Municipal councils pass by-laws affecting only the local community.
ze: 市鎮議會通過只影響當地的地方法規。

q: Who reviews bills besides the House of Commons before they become law?
zq: 除了眾議院，法案成為法律前還由誰審議？
e: Both chambers must pass a bill, then it receives royal assent.
ze: 兩院都須通過法案，之後才獲御准。

q: How many candidates can there be in an electoral district?
zq: 一個選區可以有幾位候選人？
e: The candidate who receives the most votes becomes the MP.
ze: 得票最多的候選人成為國會議員。

q: What is the National Register of Electors?
zq: 什麼是「全國選民登記冊」？
o: A permanent database of Canadian citizens 18 or older who are qualified to vote
zo: 有資格投票的 18 歲以上加拿大公民的永久資料庫
e: Elections Canada produces voters' lists from it.
ze: 加拿大選舉局據此製作選民名冊。

q: What does the voter information card list?
zq: 選民資訊卡上列出什麼？
o: When and where you vote, and a number to call for an interpreter or special services
zo: 你投票的時間和地點，以及需要口譯或特殊服務時的電話
e: The card is mailed once an election has been called.
ze: 選舉一經宣布就會寄出。

q: Immediately after the polling stations close, what happens?
zq: 投票站一關閉，會發生什麼？
o: Ballots are stored for a month
Election officers count the ballots and results are announced on radio, television and in newspapers
Voters go home and wait a week
zo: 選務人員開票，結果在廣播、電視和報紙公布
e: Results are made public the same night.
ze: 結果當晚公布。

q: Who runs the federal government departments?
zq: 誰負責管理聯邦政府各部門？
e: The Prime Minister chooses the ministers, mostly from the House of Commons.
ze: 總理挑選部長，多數來自眾議院。

q: Who prepares the budget and proposes most new laws?
zq: 誰編列預算並提出大多數新法律？
e: Cabinet decisions can be questioned by all members of the House of Commons.
ze: 內閣決定可受所有眾議院議員質詢。

q: What is the role of the opposition parties?
zq: 反對黨的角色是什麼？
o: To peacefully oppose or try to improve government proposals
zo: 和平地反對或設法改善政府提案
e: The largest opposition party is the Official Opposition.
ze: 最大的反對黨是官方反對黨。

q: What should you bring to the polling station on election day?
zq: 選舉日去投票站要帶什麼？
o: Your voter information card and proof of identity and address
zo: 選民資訊卡以及身分和地址證明
e: The polling station location is on your voter information card.
ze: 投票站地點在選民資訊卡上。

q: If you did not get a voter information card and do not have your local elections office number, whom can you call?
zq: 如果沒收到選民資訊卡也沒有當地選舉辦公室的電話，可以打給誰？
zo: 渥太華的加拿大選舉局 1-800-463-6868
e: You can be added to the voters' list at any time, even on election day.
ze: 你隨時可以被加入選民名冊，甚至在選舉日。
